notes.title: It's Time To Dig Deep!
notes.content: We've hit the mother lode – Steam Achievements for End of the Mine are here! You've delved into the mine and excavated its secrets. Now stake your claim to bravery and glory with 62 shiny achievements! Travel back down into Mine 23 to fight and explore the planet once more, but beware – unlocking every achievement will test your mettle in more ways than one.

notes.title: MINE 23 UPDATE 11.7.2016
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 11.7.2016[/h1]

Bug Fixes and Changes
[list]
[*]Multi-monitor fix, Added a button in the option under the graphics tab that cycles through the monitors.
[*]Added progress bars in level select. 
[*]Player low health sound does not continually play while player is at low health. 
[*]Fixed level 2 pick-ax being ineffective while facing left. 
[*]Crossbow damages enemies consistently. 
[*]Switching to Windowed mode updates immediately. 
[*]Tutorial for how to throw TnT shows consistently. 
[*]Revamped the background sound system to more accurately play the sounds. 
[*]Mushroom King’s mushrooms are now able to be destroyed. 
[*]Fixed various boss projectiles to be destructible and colliders on bosses. 
[*]Most bosses flash red when damaged. 
[*]Several minor bug fixes. 


We have some exciting new updates for all you miners out there. Be sure to check out the new additions! We're working on the Mac version as well, and that should be up within the next few days. Until next time! Happy Mining!

notes.title: MINE UPDATE 10.31.2016
notes.content:
Update 10.31.2016
[*]Various bug fixes
[*]Enemy & boss balancing
[*]Fix dynamite exploding on the player
[*]Adjusted backwards enemy spawn points in the Puddle
[*]Improved boss arena ambiance 
[*]Adjusted Difficulties on Several Bosses
[*]Fixed invincibility bug on Sickle Skull Bros
[*]Re-Attached All-Peepers Laser to his eye
[*]Fixed Layer issue with boss foregrounds
[*]Fixed various projectile explosions
[*]Lowered boss injury sounds across the board
[*]Turned down sub boss intros
[*]Turned off sound effects when game is paused
[*]Turned down cave stalactite sounds
[*]Fixed enemy projectiles 
[*]Improved mobility of bugs in the cave
[*]Fixed enemy sounds
[*]Balanced enemy damage and effectiveness

Happy Halloween!!! We've been working hard to keep End of the Mine up to date. Here 's a list of the things we fixed due to your positive feedback! Keep em' coming and happy mining!

notes.title: End of the Mine launches October 28th!
notes.content:
Amazing news: we've got a release date! End of the Mine will blast its way onto Steam this Friday, October 28th! Thanks to everyone for being patient as we polished up the game. The wait is almost over!

If you're not a fan of digital copies, be sure to check out [url=http://www.skirmishentertainment.com/store]our store page[/url] 
where you can snag the physical Collector's Edition and other End of the Mine goodies!

notes.title: Skirmish Store is Now Open!
notes.content:
Hey folks! Today we're announcing that the [url=http://www.skirmishentertainment.com/store]Skirmish Store[/url] is open for business! 

We're doing a [b]limited[/b] collector's edition release for End of the Mine that can only be found in our store. This physical collector's edition includes:

[list]
[*]Custom designed End of the Mine crate box 
[*]EOTM Styled CD & Case 
[*]Manual/Information Booklet 
[*]4” V.S. Sticker 
[*]4” Eyeball Medallion with Digital Code on back 
[*]Miner I.D. Card 
[*]Project Synth Promo Card
[/list]

Only [b]1000[/b] of these have been made, so if you want one, order soon!

We also have Camm-E plushies, EOTM T-shirts, and EOTM posters up for sale in the store. If you missed out on getting these during our Kickstarter campaign, fret not. You can now order them straight from our website! Head on over to [url=http://www.skirmishentertainment.com/store]our store[/url] to place your orders today!

notes.title: Skirmish Entertainment will be at PAX West!
notes.content: We will be showcasing and launching the release of our game End of the Mine at PAX West! We will be in the PAX Rising area, so if you're attending, be sure to stop by and say hi. We will have awesome items/free swag and you will be able to play the game! Our mobile game Endless Mine will also be on display – be sure to grab it from the iOS and Google Play stores on August 23rd, it's free!

notes.title: End of the Mine Kickstarter Campaign is LIVE!
notes.content:
Attention Miners!

We are incredibly excited to announce the relaunch of our Kickstarter campaign for End of the Mine. We learned so much the first time around and have taken every measure to vastly improve our new campaign. We want to start off by giving a huge shout out and THANK YOU to all of our backers from our first campaign. Your support was incredible and we hope you will continue to believe in us as we move forward! We’re also very excited to have unveiled the new trailer to you all of you and hope you enjoy it as much as we do. That was just one of the many things we’ve been working on recently. We have an all new look throughout this new campaign and we’ve re-done our rewards to give you guys more bang for your buck. We have also been working incredibly hard to make great improvements in our demo thanks to all of the feedback we’ve been receiving! If you haven’t played the demo yet, go ahead and check it out and let us know what you think! We hope you enjoy and for all new backers and supporters, thank you so much and welcome to the Skirmish family!


Check out our Kickstarter here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1370596581/end-of-the-mine-relaunch
